title: Multi-brainstorm · Jitter
summary: Discover the latest features, updates and improvements of Jitter, the fast and simple motion design tool on the web. Try Jitter for free now.
body_markdown:
You can now explore multiple creative directions with AI Brainstorm in a single click: great for kicking off a new project, finding the right motion style for a brand, or comparing concepts before committing to one.


Here’s how to brainstorm several directions in parallel:


1. Select your scene, click on the ✨ icon in the top right corner, and select *Brainstorm* .
2. When it suggests creative directions in the chat, select several at once — or type your own.
3. Click *Continue* , and you'll get a separate animation for each direction you chose.


That's it! From here, you'll be able to explore a range of possibilities upfront, compare ideas side by side, and keep developing the one that fits your creative vision best.


## Other improvements


- More export frame rates: You can now export at 23.976, 24, and 29.97 FPS. This lets you match your project’s frame rate so that Jitter animations drop straight into your video edits without stutter or dropped frames.
- Faster rendering for layered effects: Files that combine blend modes, blur, or glass effects with opacity or shadows now render much faster than before.
- A steadier playhead: The playhead now stays put when you select animations, so you don’t lose your place in the timeline. You can also snap animations to it while dragging, making it easier to time things to an exact moment.
